evd_title: GPT 4-0613 achieved the lowest correct answer rate of 44.1% among all tested LLMs on STROBE questions
finding: GPT 4-0613 achieved the lowest correct answer rate of 44.1% among all tested LLMs on STROBE questions
P: 39 observational obesity studies from PubMed; 15 STROBE questions x 10 trials (5850 QA pairs)
I: GPT 4-0613 with RAG (LanceDB + ada-002 embeddings), zero-shot, T=0.1
C: Gemini Pro 1.0, GPT 3.5-turbo-1106 and other LLMs; gold answers from 1 medical professor
O: % correct: GPT-4-0613 44.1% vs Gemini Pro 49.2% (p<.001) vs GPT-3.5-turbo 66.9%
T: PubMed search 19 Dec 2023; 28/39 articles pre Sep-2021 cutoff; paper 2024
